report_name: CISA Retires Six Free Cybersecurity Assessment Services

tools.name: Cyber Security Evaluation Tool
tools.description: A tool provided by CISA for organizations to conduct detailed security assessments against various standards. Previously used by CISA advisors in hands-on assessments, it is now recommended for self-service use by critical infrastructure operators.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: U.S. government agency that announced the retirement of six free, hands-on cybersecurity assessment services (including the Cyber Resilience Review and Ransomware Readiness Assessment) to reduce redundancy and encourage use of self-service tools like the Cybersecurity Performance Goals (CPGs).

identities.name: U.S. critical infrastructure operators
identities.description: A class of public and private sector organizations, including water utilities, hospitals, and SLTT governments, that are affected by CISA's retirement of free, hands-on cybersecurity assessment services.
